<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Fortuneteller Baba's Palace''' (Baba's Palace) rises from the sea on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. It's the home of the Earth's [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]], who teaches a couple of basic skills and hosts [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] in her arena.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]]''' teaches [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] and Meditation, and her '''Tournament''' option opens the tournament screen. She has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
{{Main|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament}}
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The palace is a tournament arena. Baba's tournament is a gauntlet with knockout bouts (nobody dies), the easiest of the three [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournaments]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Protection == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
The palace is both a master's home and a tournament arena: ki attacks can't damage it, and survival or adventure players, explosions and mob griefing can't build in it or break it, unless the server changes the matching gamerules (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:12-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:13-->
The palace generates once per world, in an ocean. It also shows up in worlds created before it was added (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Existing worlds|Existing worlds]]). Every [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] of tier 3 or higher sells a '''Fortuneteller Baba's Palace Map''' for 6 Glass Bottles and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate baba_palace}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 23, ''Fortuneteller Baba'': find Fortuneteller Baba's Palace and talk to Fortuneteller Baba.
</translate>
